firm_data.firm_description: Morgan & Morgan is America's Largest Personal Injury Law Firm, dedicated to fighting for the people, not the powerful. With a team of over 1,000 attorneys, the firm has recovered $30 billion for its clients.
notable_facts: The firm was founded in 1988 by John and Ultima Morgan.
The firm is licensed in all 50 states.

email.subject: AI for Morgan & Morgan, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Chaim,

With 1,000 attorneys across 140 offices and $30 billion recovered for clients, Morgan & Morgan operates at scale most firms can't match. That scale creates unique demands on your tech stack, especially when coordinating personal injury cases across 50 states.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms managing complexity without proportional overhead. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding into Florida. I'd be happy to stop by your Orlando office to show how we're helping similar firms compete without adding headcount.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
